title: Vanishing criterion: the co-area Jacobian is zero iff df_x composed with a tangent parametrization is not surjective
statement:
Let N, m, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝᴺ, f : ℝᴺ → ℝᵐ and x ∈ ℝᴺ, where ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n).
Let A : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ be a continuous linear map with tangentSpace M x = range A.
Then coareaJacobian M f x = 0 if and only if (fderiv ℝ f x) ∘ A : ℝⁿ → ℝᵐ is not surjective.
lean_statement: ∀ (N m n : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (x : Rn N) (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N), tangentSpace M x = LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap → (coareaJacobian M f x = 0 ↔ ¬ Function.Surjective ((fderiv ℝ f x).comp A))
